remarks: This beautiful ranch has been expanded with a second floor that includes an office space, a playroom and a huge (ready to finish) space that would make a great primary suite! With 2,126 sq ft of living space as well as an additional 1642 sq ft in the lower level there is plenty of room for everyone. Situated on 0.71 acres with lush landscaping and privacy screening trees, the property features an Outdoor Oasis with huge screened porch, teak deck and hot tub. The main floor includes the primary bedroom with private bath, two additional bedrooms with a large hall bathroom with double sinks, living room with oversized fireplace, dining room with charming original built ins, eat in kitchen and mud room. Hardwood floors throughout the main living areas create a warm and inviting atmosphere. The lower level provides additional recreation space with a second fireplace and ample room for games, lounging, workouts or storage. 2 exterior sheds (one with electricity, heat and a/c) complete the property. This impeccably maintained and versatile home is "move in ready" or can be customized to suit your lifestyle.
